certification.feasibility_note: zero-error accepts needed: 299 (1%), 149 (2%), 59 (5%). The Phase 4b rule accepted 289 of the B items, so 1% cannot be certified on B by any veto
certification.method: Learn-Then-Test fixed-sequence over tau_sequence in order (strict -> loose), each hypothesis 'false-accept share > alpha' rejected iff the one-sided Clopper-Pearson upper bound at delta is <= alpha; stop at the first failure

checker.input: (evidence units joined by a space, claim), evidence truncated first
checker.targets: true claim -> entailment, fake claim -> contradiction (3-way head kept)

heldout: B_test COVID-Fact items the panel judged (the 1,856 of Phase 4b); scored exactly once

no_regression.pass_if: precision after >= precision before AND correct accepts lost <= max(1, 5% of correct accepts before)

note: HealthVer and COVID-Fact: internal, unlicensed datasets; aggregates only, no text or per-item output committed

primary.why: panel + frozen Phase 4b structural veto is the current best frozen rule; r0.90 is the middle of the declared sequence

success: primary setting certified at 5% on B AND every no-regression set passes
tau_rule: for retention r, tau_r = ascending-sorted P(support) of ALL true A_dev claims at index floor((1-r)*n)
veto: accept-only: ACCEPT -> NOT_SURE iff checker P(support) < tau or the score is missing; BLOCK and NOT_SURE never change, so the checker can only remove accepts
